hint.text: Commas are used to separate items in a list. There should be a comma between all items in a list, except between the last two items. Here, instead of a comma, there should be the word 'and' or 'or'.

atoms.a: Betty and Priya are planning a birthday party. They have been planning this party for months. They sent out handwritten invites to all of their friends, decorated the house, purchased a chocolate birthday cake from the bakers and made a lasagne to serve to the guests.

atoms.a: Xander went to a shopping center to buy gifts for his family members. He bought lots of different things. He bought a toy car for his niece, a doll for his nephew, a recipe book for his dad, a new thriller novel for his mum and a pair of headphones for his sister.

atoms.a: It takes Xander a long time to travel to his parents’ house. He must ride in a taxi to the train station in Valencia, catch a train to the airport, fly in a plane for three hours, catch another train to the train station in Manchester and walk to his parents’ house.
